rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 2-4 report the authors' own ML/CDF-matching downscaling of SMAP soil moisture with Planet SuperDove imagery over the Yanco region, validated against 14 in situ stations (Tables 5-6) and HDAS intensive sampling (Figure 5).
rows.notes: The study develops and validates a method for mapping 3-m surface soil moisture from SMAP and Planet SuperDove data; it reports accuracy against in situ measurements (RMSE ~0.07 cm3/cm3, R ~0.86) and captures irrigation- and vegetation-related wetness patterns. It does not report any result on remote sensing supporting soil management or soil quality maintenance; applications to water resources management and precision agriculture are only mentioned as potential uses in the abstract, discussion and conclusions. Mapping soil moisture is at most a precondition of the claimed soil-management effect, so Q2 is 'no' and upstream is set.

notes: Full text available; some pages have duplicated/garbled two-column layout but content is complete. The study is a remote-sensing methods paper on soil moisture downscaling, not on soil quality or soil management outcomes.
